cultivars.name: Amara
cultivars.note: Not the usual mustard green (B. juncea). Amara is Ethiopian mustard, B. carinata.

taxa.taxonomy_note: Taxonomies disagree here. POWO accepts Mutarda carinata and treats Brassica carinata as a synonym. GBIF and NCBI still accept Brassica carinata A.Braun (GBIF 3042925, NCBI 52824, with Mutarda carinata as an NCBI synonym). The GBIF key given is for B. carinata, because a GBIF match on 'Mutarda carinata' only reached genus level. NCBI taxid read from the NCBI Taxonomy checklist that GBIF mirrors (dataset fab88965-e69d-4491-a04d-e3198b626e52), because the NCBI pages could not be reached directly (browser rate-limited, E-utilities blocked by robots.txt). WFO id is null because worldfloraonline.org could not be fetched (TLS/robots failure).
